name: Shadow Stalkers
background:
Shadow Stalkers are elusive and alien creatures from another plane, which appear strange and unsettling to most Tyrians. Their bizarre and uncanny armies strike terror into the heart of any who dare to face them. 

The Shadow Stalkers were brought to Tyria through a flaw in their Voidgates, which left permanent scars throughout their home plane. Desperate to save their home, these mysterious entities ventured through the Voidgates to Tyria, shutting off their only path of return. Now, they are trapped in an unfamiliar plane, uncertain if their sacrifice was enough to save their home.
backgroundFull:
Shadow Stalkers lived in relative harmony in their strange, lightless plane, known to them as the Labyrinth. They dwelt in cities scattered among the ancient winding paths, using their plane’s ambient magical aura to navigate in the darkness. This changed when the Voidgates began to appear in their plane. 

The Voidgates interfered with the Labyrinth’s magic. The fungi and mosses near the newly opened gates withered and animals shunned them. Shadow Stalkers who lingered close to these Voidgates too long became weak and ill. Soon it was discovered that the magic permeating the Labyrinth was slowly draining life from the Plane through the gate and unless action was taken, their home would become uninhabitable.

The Shadow Stalkers began to investigate the other side of the Voidgate. Near the Voidgates, there were traces of the Labyrinth’s magic, manifesting as a faint miasma which allowed them to sense their surroundings. As they moved further, however, they discovered that magic in Tyria operated very differently than in the Labyrinth. Rather than permeating the plane like air, magical power in Tyria was far more concentrated, and magic users were like bright lights in total darkness. They were able to detect these magic users opening new Voidgates throughout their plane, heedless of the damage their spells caused. 

On discovering the cause of the disturbance in their Plane, the Shadow Stalkers sought out volunteers to explore the plane of Tyria and shut the gates. They prepared relics that would allow them to sense things in Tyria, projecting their own magical auras which they could use to sense things. Soon, they were ready and began to pour out through Voidgates, destroying the gates behind them. 

They surged through the old Ogre Kingdoms, sealing any Voidgates they found which might connect to their world. The destruction of these gates left the Shadow Stalkers with no way of returning home, and they were now trapped in Tyria. Some Shadow Stalkers hid in the ruins of the cities which they seized, slowly learning to adapt to the new plane, some pursued the Ogres and their Shamans hoping to prevent them from opening new gates, while others sought a way to return home. 

How will you navigate this strange plane?

product.description: As you pass the village inn, you hear a low familiar growl of a large Shadow Stalker Hound; Kothiz is ready to welcome you. You have little doubt that his master, the Scourge Champion, Omoshu, is close behind. As the Voidgate comes into sight, you see Omoshu emerge, gripping tightly upon the rope holding Kothiz back. Other familiar Shadow Stalkers step forward on his flanks. “You were foolish to come here, light-dwellers. I have spared you once and the Mage twice, yet you have still returned to reopen that cursed wound which your people call a Voidgate. Do not expect further mercy from me.”

specialRules.name: Imprecise
specialRules.description: Gets -1 to hit when attacking.

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Sergeant
specialRules.description: This model gets AP(+1) when attacking.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
specialRules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Shadowborn
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Shadowborn, enemy units shooting/charging it get -8"/-4" range to a min. of 6" from Shadowborn (instead of only -4"/-2").

specialRules.name: Unique Hero
specialRules.description: Counts as having Hero, and this model may only be taken once per army.

specialRules.name: Thrust in Melee Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Thrust on its weapons in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Shadowborn
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for shooting/charging, that enemy unit gets -4"/-2" range to a min. of 6".

specialRules.name: Increased Shooting Range Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get +6" range on its weapons when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Ravage
specialRules.description: Once per round, when it’s this model’s turn to strike in melee, roll X dice before attacking, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.

specialRules.name: Counter in Melee Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Counter on its weapons in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Strider Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Strider. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Shadowborn Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Shadowborn. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Spell Resistance
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. If the wound was from a spell, then it is ignored on a 2+. If the wound was not from a spell, then it is ignored on a 6+ instead.

specialRules.name: Precision Target
specialRules.description: Once per game, during this model's activation, before attacking, pick X enemy units within 18" and in line of sight of it, and place one token on them. Friendly units get +1 to hit rolls when attacking them.

specialRules.name: Dodge
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, as long as they aren't Fatigued, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls in melee against them.

specialRules.name: Melee Slayer
specialRules.description: When charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(9) or higher.

specialRules.name: Ethereal
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, you may place this model anywhere fully within 6" of its position. If you do, this model moves -6" when using Advance, and -6" when using Rush/Charge until the end of that activation.

specialRules.name: Anti-Regen
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration.

specialRules.name: Destructive
specialRules.description: When attacking units with more than half of their total size or Tough value (for single-model units), those hits get AP(+1).

specialRules.name: Enhanced Shrouded
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Shrouded, enemy units shooting/charging it get -8"/-4" range to a min. of 6" from Shrouded (instead of only -4"/-2").

specialRules.name: Shrouded
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for shooting/charging, that enemy unit gets -4"/-2" range to a min. of 6".

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: AP

specialRules.name: Hero
specialRules.description: Units within 6” of friendly Heroes may use the Hero’s Quality for Morale Tests as long as the Hero isn’t Shaken.

specialRules.name: Thrust
specialRules.description: When charging, gets +1 to hit rolls and AP(+1) in melee.

specialRules.name: Counter
specialRules.description: May strike first with this weapon when charged, unless this unit is Fatigued.

specialRules.name: Strider
specialRules.description: May ignore the effects of Difficult terrain. This unit halves the number of dice it rolls when jumping (rounding up).

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Deadly
specialRules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.
